lyrics:
[Intro: slow arpeggiated electric guitar chords, bass]

[Verse 1: low, bluesy, guitar and bass]
There is a little house of light
It fits inside my hand
It's been the end of many a day
And many a thing I planned

[Verse 2: organ enters, drums soft]
My mother kept a garden
She grew her beans in rows
My father was a talking man
He knew what a neighbour knows

[Verse 3: voice rising, organ swirling]
Now all a body needs to live
Is a charger and a chair
And the only time he's satisfied
Is when he isn't there

[Organ Solo: swirling, building, drums louder]

[Verse 4: howled, full band]
So tell the little ones for me
To lift their eyes and run
Out to the yard and the daylight
While there's still a sun

[Verse 5: loud, desperate]
I've one foot on the doorstep
The other in the glow
I only meant to check the time
That was hours ago

[Verse 6: quieter, the first verse again]
There is a little house of light
It fits inside my hand
It's been the end of many a day
And Lord, I know I'm damned

[Outro: organ and guitar, slowing, final chord]
